scenario_reading.\"120\": the splinters option at its cap. data/champions.json Syndra P: 'Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath ... stacking up to 120 times' and 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.' data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json Syndra: 'E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage)'.
scenario_reading.\"custom_order\": the fight carries a non-default cast order. data/worklists/f2-task.md: the engine previously used 'a rotation resolver ... replacing the naive DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R)'; the /api/calculate response gains a 'rotation' receipt '{order: [Q,E,E,E,...], rationale: ...}'. The changed leaf is an element of exactly that receipt's order list.

step_1_sphere_setup_edge.claim: Dark Sphere (Q) is the only sphere source; W, E and R all read spheres, so every Q cast in the rotation precedes them.
quotes: Q Dark Sphere: 'Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.'

W Force of Will: 'Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units from the target location ... If a Dark Sphere is grabbed, its duration is refreshed'
E Scatter the Weak: 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units ... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds'
R Unleashed Power: 'Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres'

step_2_two_Q_casts_at_120_splinters.claim: At splinters = 120 the rotation contains TWO Dark Sphere casts (Q and the stocked second charge, the module's synthetic Q2 slot), and they occupy the first two positions as sphere setup.
quotes: data/champions.json Q: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.'

data/champion-audit/batch-6.json Syndra: 'modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)' and 'splinters option (0-120) gates Q2 second charge' and notable atom 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)'
data/wiki-atoms/stack-transform-summon-resource.json (stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo): 'stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)'
step_2_two_Q_casts_at_120_splinters.consequence: 120 >= 40, so the second charge is stocked and must appear in the cast list. order[0] = Q, order[1] = Q2.

step_3_W_outranks_E_on_the_sourced_per-r.metric: per-rank DPS = total raw damage / effective cooldown (data/worklists/f3-task.md deliverable 1b: 'RANK per-rank DPS at the fight's stats for the remaining abilities (total_raw / effective cooldown x AoE weight)')

sourced_rows_rank_max.W: Total Mixed Damage 212.8 (+76.6% AP) at 60+ splinters (base Magic 190 + 65% AP, plus the 60-splinter 12% + 2%/100 AP bonus true damage), cooldown 8 s at rank 5 (12/11/10/9/8)
sourced_rows_rank_max.E: Magic Damage 200 (+60% AP), cooldown 15 s (flat at every rank)
sourced_rows_rank_max.R: Magic Damage per Sphere 160 (+20% AP); Minimum Magic Damage 480 (+60% AP), cooldown 80 s at rank 3 (120/100/80)

step_3_W_outranks_E_on_the_sourced_per-r.conclusion: W beats E at every AP (linear coefficients 0.766/8 = 0.0958 per AP vs 0.60/15 = 0.040 per AP; the W row's extra quadratic AP term only widens the gap). Ranking is Q > W > E > R at every stat point, so W precedes E in the post-setup tail, and R -- which wants the maximum number of live spheres on the ground ('grabs up to 4 nearby live ones') -- closes the rotation.

step_4_assembled_order.note: No sourced signal places E before W. E's only Transcendent bonus at 120 splinters is utility ('increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70%'), and nothing in Syndra's kit consumes a stun or slow, so the setup/consume rule of data/worklists/f3-task.md (1a) emits no E-before-W edge; the DPS rule (1b) emits a W-before-E edge.

independent_computation.why_the_old_value_is_the_stale_one: E at order[2] is exactly the third element of the naive DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER Q,W,E,R quoted in data/worklists/f2-task.md -- i.e. the old golden had the fixed default in a scenario whose whole point is a non-default order, and it also omits the second stocked Dark Sphere cast that 120 splinters unlocks. Both hypotheses that survive the cached data ([Q, Q2, W, E, R] with the stocked charge, or a 4-cast custom order [Q, E, W, R]) put W at index 2; only the unmodified default puts E there.
